title: LandlordGuard Returned-Payment Fee Basis by Payment Amount
content:
**Size bands.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy, how the returned-fee basis is set depends on the amount of the returned payment, which is the most recently posted returned payment: a payment above 1000 USD takes the tier's returned-payment fee plus 2 percent of the part of the payment above 1000 USD; a payment of 100 USD or less takes half the tier's returned-payment fee; any other payment takes the tier's returned-payment fee.

The returned-fee basis is the starting amount of the returned-payment fee, to which the returned-fee adjustment is added.

| Amount of the most recently posted returned payment | Returned-fee basis |
|---|---|
| above 1000 USD | the tier's fee plus 2 percent of the amount above 1000 USD |
| above 100 USD and up to 1000 USD | the tier's fee |
| 100 USD or less | half the tier's fee |

## Tier fee and its half (USD)

| Tier | Returned-payment fee | Half |
|---|---|---|
| DP-1 Basic | 25.00 | 12.50 |
| DP-2 Broad | 25.00 | 12.50 |
| DP-3 Special | 25.00 | 12.50 |
| DP-3 Special Plus | 25.00 | 12.50 |
| DP-3 Premier | 20.00 | 10.00 |
| DP-3 Portfolio | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical returned payments on a tier with a 25.00 USD fee)

| Returned payment | Returned-fee basis |
|---|---|
| 1,800.00 | 25.00 plus 2 percent of 800.00 (16.00), that is 41.00 |
| 1,000.00 | 25.00 |
| 100.01 | 25.00 |
| 100.00 | 12.50 |
